backend/main.mo: Motoko actor implementing an e-commerce backend with product management, shopping cart operations per user principal, order placement with customer details, and admin authentication via password verification.
feature_evidence.json: Feature evidence report documenting two high-confidence features: fixing the useRemoveFromCart React Query hook and ensuring the CartPage Remove button properly triggers the mutation with correct product IDs.
frontend-file-summaries.txt: JSON-formatted summaries of all frontend files including components, pages, hooks, and utilities for the Swapan Store e-commerce application with Indian Rupee formatting and warm spice market theming.
frontend/index.css: Tailwind CSS configuration with custom CSS variables defining OKLCH color system for light and dark modes with neutral grayscale palette and chart colors.
frontend/index.html: HTML entry point for the Swapan Store application with root div and module script loading main.tsx.
frontend/src/App.tsx: Main React application component configuring TanStack Router with routes for products, cart, checkout, admin dashboard, and admin login, wrapped with QueryClient and InternetIdentity providers in a shared layout.
Dialog modal component with form validation for creating new products including name, description, price, category dropdown, and image URL fields with loading states and toast notifications.
frontend/src/components/EditProductModal: Dialog modal component for editing existing products, pre-populating form fields from product prop and submitting updates via useUpdateProduct mutation with validation and error handling.
frontend/src/components/Footer.tsx: Footer component displaying copyright year, Swapan Store branding, and attribution link to caffeine.ai with UTM tracking parameters derived from window hostname.
frontend/src/components/Header.tsx: Header component displaying the Swapan Store logo, navigation links (Products, Admin), and a shopping cart button with a badge showing the total number of items in the cart.
frontend/src/components/ProductCard.tsx: ProductCard component that displays a product with image, name, category, description, price, and quantity controls, allowing users to add items to their cart with a specified quantity.
frontend/src/hooks/useActor.ts: Custom hook that creates and manages the backend actor instance based on Internet Identity authentication state, automatically invalidating and refetching dependent queries when the actor changes.
frontend/src/hooks/useAdminAuth.ts: Custom hook managing admin authentication state using sessionStorage, providing login/logout functions and persisting authentication status across page reloads.
frontend/src/hooks/useInternetIdentity.t: React context provider and hook for Internet Identity authentication, managing identity state, login/logout flows, and delegation validation with configurable AuthClient options.
frontend/src/hooks/useQueries.ts: Collection of React Query hooks for data fetching and mutations including products, cart operations, orders, admin authentication, and product management (CRUD operations).
frontend/src/index.css: Tailwind CSS configuration with custom color variables defining a warm, earthy Indian spice market theme for both light and dark modes using HSL color values.
frontend/src/main.tsx: Application entry point that sets up React Query and Internet Identity providers, then renders the main App component into the DOM.
frontend/src/pages/AdminDashboard.tsx: Admin dashboard page displaying products table with inline price editing, orders list, and modals for adding/editing products, with authentication checks and local image mapping for product assets.
frontend/src/pages/AdminLoginPage.tsx: Admin login page with password verification form that uses useVerifyAdminPassword hook and useAdminAuth to authenticate and navigate to /admin dashboard.
frontend/src/pages/CartPage.tsx: Shopping cart page displaying cart items with local image mapping, quantities, prices, total calculation, and remove-from-cart functionality with navigation to checkout.
frontend/src/pages/CheckoutPage.tsx: Checkout page with phone number and address input fields, order summary with local image mapping, and place-order functionality that validates inputs and navigates to products page on success.
frontend/src/pages/ProductsPage.tsx: Main products listing page with hero banner, category filter tabs, and product grid displaying items with local image mapping from a hardcoded imageMap.
frontend/src/utils/formatPrice.ts: Utility function that formats numeric price values to Indian Rupee format with ₹ symbol prefix and two decimal places.
frontend/tailwind.config.js: Tailwind CSS configuration with custom color scheme using OKLCH color space, custom fonts (Inter, Poppins), extended shadows, animations, and plugins for typography and container queries.
project_state.json: Project state tracking file documenting the e-commerce app's features, known issues (cart removal not working in v7), architectural notes, and requirement mappings for Swapan Store.
